# Fix billing_entity_name nullable validation in payouts page

## Summary
Fixes page crashes on `/settings/payouts` for users with null `billing_entity_name` values by updating the Zod validation schema and TypeScript type definitions to allow null values.

**Changes made:**
- Changed `billing_entity_name: z.string()` to `billing_entity_name: z.string().nullable()` in payouts page schema
- Updated `BillingDetails` type definition to allow `billing_entity_name: string | null`

This addresses the reported issue where 3 users experienced failures on the payouts page, likely due to validation errors when their `billing_entity_name` was null.

## Review & Testing Checklist for Human
- [ ] **Test payouts page with null billing_entity_name**: Verify that users with null billing entity names can now successfully load `/settings/payouts` without crashes
- [ ] **Test bank account creation/editing**: Ensure that adding and editing bank accounts still works properly when billing_entity_name is null
- [ ] **Check for downstream impacts**: Verify that other parts of the system that use billing_entity_name handle null values correctly (payment processing, form submissions, etc.)

### Notes
- ⚠️ **Testing limitation**: Unable to test changes locally due to Vercel authentication requirements blocking dev server
- Found another instance of `billing_entity_name: z.string()` in `app/(dashboard)/invoices/Edit.tsx` but left unchanged as it appears to be a different context/schema
- Lint checks passed successfully
